ashley: Heads-up — saw a regression hit on prod for qwen-1.5 (inference pool) after the recent kernel selector tweak. p50 went from ~18ms to ~42ms for short-chat loads. :eyes:

ashley: Quick summary: model variant uses head_size=38, seq=128 for our benchmark. FlashAttention unexpectedly falls back to SDPA / Triton generic path at runtime for a subset of requests and KV cache hitrate drops. Throughput down ~58%.

raj: Can you paste the profiler output? I can repro locally if I get the kernel selection log.

ashley: Paste from the trace (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] request=abcd kernel_choice=flashattention_fast head_dim=38 mask=present -> crash_path=yes fallback=sdpa_generic
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] request=efgh kernel_choice=flashattention_fast head_dim=48 mask=present -> success
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] selected_kernel=sdpa_generic (p50=42.3ms)
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] selected_kernel=flash_triton (p50=19.1ms) // for padded 48
```

raj: Interesting — head_dim 38 is not a multiple of 8/16/32 which several fast kernels assume. But the selector should have explicitly chosen the safe SDPA or a padded-flash path, not mix-and-match. The mix is probably why KV cache reuse failed (different kernel abi for packed kv layout?).

matt: I dug in: there are two issues tangled here: 1) masking fallback regression in flash triton when head_dim % 8 != 0 (we hit a branch that disables the optimized kernel), 2) when we fall back, our KV cache serializer tag includes kernel_id which prevents cross-kernel cache hits -> cache miss storm.

sara: Oof. So the cache key includes runtime kernel fingerprint? That seems wrong — cache should be keyed by model version + sequence prefix hash, not ephemeral kernel selection. Can someone confirm where that was added?

matt: It was an emergency marker we added in selector v2 to avoid subtle ABI mismatches. We wanted to avoid reading KV blobs generated by one kernel with another. But the marker was too coarse (includes kernel variant rather than stable ABI properties).

raj: Repro script I used:
```
# repro.sh
python -m perf_runner --model qwen-1.5 --head-dim 38 --seq 128 --batch 8 --profile
```
Outputs show kernel flapping for different batch alignments.

ashley: Measured numbers from canary:
- baseline flash_triton (head_dim padded to 48): p50=18.6ms, throughput=105 req/s
- current mixed selector (head_dim 38): p50=42.3ms, throughput=44 req/s
- SDPA generic: p50=40.9ms, throughput=48 req/s
- padded->flash path (forced padding on load): p50=20.1ms, throughput=100 req/s

sara: Two options I see: 1) fix selector to prefer padded flash path when padding cost < fallback penalty, 2) make KV cache key based on stable ABI fingerprint (head_dim, dtype, model id) and allow controlled reuse, 3) fix flash mask code to support odd head sizes.

matt: Concerning 3) — flash attention mask broadcasting bug is non-trivial in Triton impl; fix will take days and a kernel release. Short-term we should do 1+2. Heuristic: if head_dim % 16 != 0 AND pad_cost < 12% compute, choose padded flash. Otherwise choose SDPA but keep ABI-stable cache key.

ashley: Agreed. Also need a throttle for selector churning: if kernel_choice for a model variant toggles across requests within 10s, lock to last good kernel for 60s. That prevents KV thrash.

perf-bot: created perf/regression/1867890123 and assigned to @matt and @raj :memo:
https://tracker.internal/perf/regression/1867890123

raj: I'll open a PR with the cache-key change (replace kernel_id -> abi_props = [head_dim, dtype, kv_layout_version]). Keeping kernel_id in logs still.

matt: I'll implement the selector heuristic patch and the short-term sticky lock. I'll add an opt-in config flag so Dedicated tenants can force safe SDPA.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for selector-v2-patch to inference-pool-3 (10%) at 2026-03-17T15:10:00Z. Will monitor latency and KV hitrate.

ashley: Thanks. Follow-up: Please add a small regression test in perf-harness that cycles head_dim in [32,38,48,96] and asserts stable kernel selection and KV hitrate > 85% for warm cache.

sara: Adding test now. Also adding a note to docs about head_dim padding tradeoffs.

matt: If anyone hits this on other models (mixtral, mistral, llama), paste perf numbers here. We should generalize heuristic per-arch.

ashley: Will do. For now, tracking in the perf/regression ticket. :white_check_mark:
